# `skillset create`

> Generated from Skillset's CLI presentation contract. See the [documentation system](../../development/documentation-system.md).

Create a named Skillset repository.

## Usage

```text
skillset create [name] [--root <parent-directory>] [--yes] [--targets claude,codex,cursor] [--include ci] [--json]
```

## Options

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--include <value>...` | Include an optional init scaffold component. |
| `--json` | Emit exactly one versioned finite JSON result document. |
| `--root <value>` | Select the repository root; defaults to cwd or Git root according to the route. |
| `--targets <value>` | Select the initial provider set written by init. |
| `--yes` | Confirm a fully specified plan-first mutation without prompting. |

## Examples

```text
skillset create
skillset create team-loadout --yes
```
